units: WPF DIP; font size is WPF FontSize, not points
precedence: Current runtime resources and matching current screenshot; then newest MASTER supplement; historical prototype parameters are not overrides.

namedValues.UiFontFamily: Microsoft YaHei UI, Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Global User Interface

setters.content:
<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" Property="Control.Template">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:ControlTemplate>
              <ns0:Border BorderBrush="{DynamicResource FocusBrush}" BorderThickness="2" CornerRadius="4" Margin="2" SnapsToDevicePixels="True" IsHitTestVisible="False" />
            </ns0:ControlTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" Property="Control.Template">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:ControlTemplate>
              <ns0:Border BorderBrush="{DynamicResource FocusBrush}" BorderThickness="2" CornerRadius="{Binding ActualHeight,RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self},Converter={StaticResource HalfHeightRadius}}" Margin="2" SnapsToDevicePixels="True" IsHitTestVisible="False" />
            </ns0:ControlTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:ns2="clr-namespace:ArchivePassword.Desktop" Property="Template">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="ToggleButton">
              <ns0:Border ns1:Name="RevealSurface" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" CornerRadius="4">
                <ns0:Grid>
                  <ns2:FluentIcon ns1:Name="RevealEye" Kind="Eye" Foreground="{TemplateBinding Foreground}" Width="20" Height="20" />
                </ns0:Grid>
              </ns0:Border>
              <ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="RevealEye" Property="local:FluentIcon.Kind" Value="EyeOff" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="RevealSurface" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource HoverBrush}" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
              </ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            </ns0:ControlTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" Property="Template">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
              <ns0:Grid>
                <ns0:Border Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" CornerRadius="{Binding ActualHeight,RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self},Converter={StaticResource HalfHeightRadius}}" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                  <ns0:ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" RecognizesAccessKey="True" />
                </ns0:Border>
                <ns0:Border ns1:Name="Overlay" CornerRadius="{Binding ActualHeight,RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self},Converter={StaticResource HalfHeightRadius}}" Background="{DynamicResource HoverBrush}" Opacity="0" IsHitTestVisible="False" />
              </ns0:Grid>
              <ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="Overlay" Property="Opacity" Value="1" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True"><ns0:Setter TargetName="Overlay" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource PressedBrush}" />
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="Overlay" Property="Opacity" Value="1" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                  <ns0:Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.45" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
              </ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            </ns0:ControlTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" Property="Template"><ns0:Setter.Value><ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="Button"><ns0:Border ns1:Name="PrimarySurface" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" CornerRadius="{Binding ActualHeight,RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self},Converter={StaticResource HalfHeightRadius}}" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}"><ns0:ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="{TemplateBinding HorizontalContentAlignment}" VerticalAlignment="Center" RecognizesAccessKey="True" /></ns0:Border><ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers><ns0:Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True"><ns0:Setter TargetName="PrimarySurface" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource AccentHoverBrush}" /></ns0:Trigger><ns0:Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True"><ns0:Setter TargetName="PrimarySurface" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource AccentHoverBrush}" /></ns0:Trigger><ns0:Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False"><ns0:Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.45" /></ns0:Trigger></ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers></ns0:ControlTemplate></ns0:Setter.Value></ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" Property="Template">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
              <ns0:Border ns1:Name="SubtleSurface" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" CornerRadius="{Binding ActualHeight,RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self},Converter={StaticResource HalfHeightRadius}}" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                <ns0:ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" RecognizesAccessKey="True" />
              </ns0:Border>
              <ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="SubtleSurface" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource HoverBrush}" />
                  <ns0:Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource TextBrush}" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="SubtleSurface" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource SelectionBrush}" />
                  <ns0:Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource SelectionTextBrush}" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                  <ns0:Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.6" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
              </ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            </ns0:ControlTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" Property="Template">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="TextBox">
              <ns0:Grid>
                <ns0:Border ns1:Name="FieldSurface" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" CornerRadius="4">
                  <ns0:ScrollViewer ns1:Name="PART_ContentHost" Margin="0" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}" VerticalAlignment="Stretch" Focusable="False" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="{TemplateBinding ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility}" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="{TemplateBinding ScrollViewer.VerticalScrollBarVisibility}" />
                </ns0:Border>
                <ns0:Border ns1:Name="FieldFocus" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource FocusBrush}" BorderThickness="2" CornerRadius="4" Visibility="Collapsed" IsHitTestVisible="False" />
              </ns0:Grid>
              <ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocusWithin" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="FieldFocus" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="Validation.HasError" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="FieldFocus" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" />
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="FieldFocus" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource ErrorBrush}" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                  <ns0:Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.6" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="loc:FieldState.HasError" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="FieldFocus" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" />
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="FieldFocus" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource ErrorBrush}" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
              </ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            </ns0:ControlTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" Property="Template">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="PasswordBox">
              <ns0:Grid>
                <ns0:Border ns1:Name="FieldSurface" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" CornerRadius="4">
                  <ns0:ScrollViewer ns1:Name="PART_ContentHost" Margin="0" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}" VerticalAlignment="Stretch" Focusable="False" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="{TemplateBinding ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility}" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="{TemplateBinding ScrollViewer.VerticalScrollBarVisibility}" />
                </ns0:Border>
                <ns0:Border ns1:Name="FieldFocus" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource FocusBrush}" BorderThickness="2" CornerRadius="4" Visibility="Collapsed" IsHitTestVisible="False" />
              </ns0:Grid>
              <ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocusWithin" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="FieldFocus" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="Validation.HasError" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="FieldFocus" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" />
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="FieldFocus" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource ErrorBrush}" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                  <ns0:Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.6" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="loc:FieldState.HasError" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="FieldFocus" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" />
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="FieldFocus" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource ErrorBrush}" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
              </ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            </ns0:ControlTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:ns2="clr-namespace:ArchivePassword.Desktop" Property="Template">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="Expander">
              <ns0:DockPanel>
                <ns0:ToggleButton ns1:Name="HeaderSite" DockPanel.Dock="Top" MinHeight="28" Background="Transparent" Foreground="{TemplateBinding Foreground}" FocusVisualStyle="{StaticResource FocusStyle}" IsChecked="{Binding IsExpanded,RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent},Mode=TwoWay}" Content="{TemplateBinding Header}" ContentTemplate="{TemplateBinding HeaderTemplate}" ContentStringFormat="{TemplateBinding HeaderStringFormat}" HorizontalContentAlignment="Stretch">
                  <ns0:ToggleButton.Template>
                    <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="ToggleButton">
                      <ns0:Border ns1:Name="ExpanderHover" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" CornerRadius="4" Padding="0,4">
                        <ns0:Grid>
                          <ns0:Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ns0:ColumnDefinition Width="24" />
                            <ns0:ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                          </ns0:Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                          <ns2:FluentIcon ns1:Name="Chevron" Kind="ChevronRight" Foreground="{TemplateBinding Foreground}" Width="12" Height="12" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="2,0,0,0" />
                          <ns0:ContentPresenter Grid.Column="1" Content="{TemplateBinding Content}" ContentTemplate="{TemplateBinding ContentTemplate}" ContentStringFormat="{TemplateBinding ContentStringFormat}" RecognizesAccessKey="True" VerticalAlignment="Center" TextElement.Foreground="{TemplateBinding Foreground}" />
                        </ns0:Grid>
                      </ns0:Border>
                      <ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        <ns0:Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
                          <ns0:Setter TargetName="Chevron" Property="loc:FluentIcon.Kind" Value="ChevronDown" />
                          <ns0:Setter TargetName="Chevron" Property="Width" Value="12" />
                          <ns0:Setter TargetName="Chevron" Property="Height" Value="12" />
                        </ns0:Trigger>
                        <ns0:Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                          <ns0:Setter TargetName="ExpanderHover" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource HoverBrush}" />
                        </ns0:Trigger>
                      </ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ns0:ControlTemplate>
                  </ns0:ToggleButton.Template>
                </ns0:ToggleButton>
                <ns0:ContentPresenter ns1:Name="ExpandSite" ContentSource="Content" Visibility="Collapsed" />
              </ns0:DockPanel>
              <ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsExpanded" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="ExpandSite" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                  <ns0:Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.6" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
              </ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            </ns0:ControlTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:ns2="clr-namespace:ArchivePassword.Desktop" Property="Template">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="ComboBox">
              <ns0:Grid>
                <ns0:ToggleButton ns1:Name="DropDownToggle" Focusable="False" ClickMode="Press" IsChecked="{Binding IsDropDownOpen,RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent},Mode=TwoWay}" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}">
                  <ns0:ToggleButton.Template>
                    <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="ToggleButton">
                      <ns0:Border Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" CornerRadius="4">
                        <ns2:FluentIcon Kind="ChevronDown" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextBrush}" Width="12" Height="12" HorizontalAlignment="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,12,0" />
                      </ns0:Border>
                    </ns0:ControlTemplate>
                  </ns0:ToggleButton.Template>
                </ns0:ToggleButton>
                <ns0:ContentPresenter ns1:Name="SelectionContent" Content="{TemplateBinding SelectionBoxItem}" ContentTemplate="{TemplateBinding SelectionBoxItemTemplate}" ContentTemplateSelector="{TemplateBinding ItemTemplateSelector}" ContentStringFormat="{TemplateBinding SelectionBoxItemStringFormat}" IsHitTestVisible="False" Margin="8,6,32,6" VerticalAlignment="Center" TextElement.Foreground="{TemplateBinding Foreground}" />
                <ns0:TextBox ns1:Name="PART_EditableTextBox" Visibility="Hidden" Style="{x:Null}" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" Foreground="{TemplateBinding Foreground}" CaretBrush="{DynamicResource TextBrush}" BorderThickness="0" Margin="8,6,32,6" VerticalContentAlignment="Center" IsReadOnly="{TemplateBinding IsReadOnly}" FocusVisualStyle="{StaticResource FocusStyle}" />
                <ns0:Popup ns1:Name="PART_Popup" Placement="Bottom" IsOpen="{TemplateBinding IsDropDownOpen}" AllowsTransparency="True" Focusable="False" PopupAnimation="None">
                  <ns0:Border Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceBrush}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="6" MinWidth="{Binding ActualWidth,RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}" MaxHeight="{TemplateBinding MaxDropDownHeight}" Padding="2">
                    <ns0:ScrollViewer CanContentScroll="True" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                      <ns0:ItemsPresenter KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigation="Contained" />
                    </ns0:ScrollViewer>
                  </ns0:Border>
                </ns0:Popup>
              </ns0:Grid>
              <ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsEditable" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="SelectionContent" Property="Visibility" Value="Hidden" />
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="PART_EditableTextBox" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" />
                  <ns0:Setter Property="IsTabStop" Value="False" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocusWithin" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="DropDownToggle" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource FocusBrush}" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="DropDownToggle" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource FocusBrush}" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                  <ns0:Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.6" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
              </ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            </ns0:ControlTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" Property="Template">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="ComboBoxItem">
              <ns0:Border ns1:Name="Item" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                <ns0:ContentPresenter />
              </ns0:Border>
              <ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsHighlighted" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="Item" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource SelectionBrush}" />
                  <ns0:Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource SelectionTextBrush}" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="Item" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}" />
                  <ns0:Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource OnAccentBrush}" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                  <ns0:Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.6" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
              </ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            </ns0:ControlTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" Property="ContentTemplate">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:DataTemplate>
              <ns0:AccessText Text="{Binding}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
            </ns0:DataTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" Property="Template">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="CheckBox">
              <ns0:Grid Background="Transparent">
                <ns0:Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                  <ns0:ColumnDefinition Width="18" />
                  <ns0:ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                </ns0:Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ns0:Border ns1:Name="Box" Width="18" Height="18" Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceBrush}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="3" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                  <ns0:Grid>
                    <ns0:Path ns1:Name="Tick" Visibility="Collapsed" Data="M2,7 L6,11 L13,3" Stroke="{DynamicResource OnAccentBrush}" StrokeThickness="2" />
                    <ns0:Rectangle ns1:Name="Mixed" Visibility="Collapsed" Height="2" Margin="3,0" Fill="{DynamicResource OnAccentBrush}" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                  </ns0:Grid>
                </ns0:Border>
                <ns0:ContentPresenter ns1:Name="CheckContent" Grid.Column="1" Margin="8,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" RecognizesAccessKey="True" />
              </ns0:Grid>
              <ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="HasContent" Value="False"><ns0:Setter TargetName="CheckContent" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" /></ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="Box" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}" />
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="Box" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}" />
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="Tick" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="{x:Null}">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="Box" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}" />
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="Mixed" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="Box" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource FocusBrush}" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                  <ns0:Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.6" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
              </ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            </ns0:ControlTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" Property="Template">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="DataGridRow">
              <ns0:Border ns1:Name="RowSurface" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" SnapsToDevicePixels="True" CornerRadius="0">
                <ns0:Grid>
                  <ns0:DataGridCellsPresenter ItemsPanel="{TemplateBinding ItemsPanel}" SnapsToDevicePixels="{TemplateBinding SnapsToDevicePixels}" />
                  <ns0:Border Height="1" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Background="{DynamicResource DividerBrush}" IsHitTestVisible="False" />
                  <ns0:Border ns1:Name="SelectionBar" Width="3" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="0,8" CornerRadius="0,2,2,0" Background="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}" Visibility="Collapsed" IsHitTestVisible="False" />
                  <ns0:Border ns1:Name="RowFocus" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource FocusBrush}" BorderThickness="2" CornerRadius="4" Margin="2" Visibility="Collapsed" IsHitTestVisible="False" />
                </ns0:Grid>
              </ns0:Border>
              <ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="RowSurface" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource HoverBrush}" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="RowSurface" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource SelectionBrush}" />

                  <ns0:Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource SelectionTextBrush}" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
                <ns0:Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocusWithin" Value="True">
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="RowFocus" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" />
                  <ns0:Setter TargetName="SelectionBar" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" />
                </ns0:Trigger>
              </ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            </ns0:ControlTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" Property="Template">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="DataGridCell">
              <ns0:Border Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                <ns0:ContentPresenter SnapsToDevicePixels="{TemplateBinding SnapsToDevicePixels}" />
              </ns0:Border>
            </ns0:ControlTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" Property="ItemsPanel">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:ItemsPanelTemplate>
              <ns0:StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" />
            </ns0:ItemsPanelTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" Property="ItemContainerStyle">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:Style TargetType="ListBoxItem">
              <ns0:Setter Property="Padding" Value="14,8" />
              <ns0:Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,6,0" />
              <ns0:Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{StaticResource CapsuleFocusStyle}" />
              <ns0:Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource SurfaceBrush}" />
              <ns0:Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource TextBrush}" />
              <ns0:Setter Property="Template">
                <ns0:Setter.Value>
                  <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                    <ns0:Border Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ButtonBorderBrush}" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="{Binding ActualHeight,RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self},Converter={StaticResource HalfHeightRadius}}" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                      <ns0:ContentPresenter />
                    </ns0:Border>
                    <ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                      <ns0:Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                        <ns0:Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource HoverBrush}" />
                      </ns0:Trigger>
                      <ns0:Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                        <ns0:Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}" />
                        <ns0:Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource OnAccentBrush}" />
                      </ns0:Trigger>
                    </ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                  </ns0:ControlTemplate>
                </ns0:Setter.Value>
              </ns0:Setter>
            </ns0:Style>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" Property="ItemTemplate">
          <ns0:Setter.Value>
            <ns0:DataTemplate>
              <ns0:StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                <ns0:TextBlock Text="{Binding Label}" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                <ns0:Border Background="{DynamicResource HoverBrush}" CornerRadius="10" Padding="6,2" Margin="6,0,0,0">
                  <ns0:TextBlock Text="{Binding Count}" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextBrush}" FontSize="12" />
                </ns0:Border>
              </ns0:StackPanel>
            </ns0:DataTemplate>
          </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>

<ns0:Setter xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" Property="Template">
                <ns0:Setter.Value>
                  <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                    <ns0:Border Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ButtonBorderBrush}" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="{Binding ActualHeight,RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self},Converter={StaticResource HalfHeightRadius}}" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                      <ns0:ContentPresenter />
                    </ns0:Border>
                    <ns0:ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                      <ns0:Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
